notablePrerequisites: You control three lands that can tap to produce at least {1}{U}{R}.
description:
Cast Frantic Search by paying {2}{U}.
Holding priority, activate Nivix Guildmage by paying {U}{R}, copying Frantic Search.
Resolve the Frantic Search copy, looting twice and untapping three lands capable of producing at least {1}{U}{R}.
Activate the lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.
